correctness.rationale: For all n>=1 and k=0,...,n, Legendre’s formula gives ν₂(F(k))=2s₂(k) and ν₂(C(3n,n))=2s₂(n)-s₂(3n). Hence ν₂(Q_{n,k})=s₂(3n)+2c_n(k) exactly. Zero-carry indices are precisely 2^{s₂(n)} binary submasks. Symmetric pairing contributes a normalized odd unit per zero-carry pair, while nonzero-carry pairs and the central term vanish at the next mod-2 level. Exactly 2^{s₂(n)-1} such pairs imply the all-n parity criterion. Guo’s Theorem 1.2 separately guarantees integrality. Full proof with all boundaries in RESULT.md; independent exact computation through n=512 passed.
